finding: The subsquare/cyclic-label class of 1RQLS10 is equivalent at the 75-cell level to an orthonormal representation of L(K5,5,5) in C10. Numerical searches are not reliable discriminators here (they miss the exactly verified K6,6,6 control), so no K5,5,5 claim is made.
remaining_gap: Existence of an L(K5,5,5) orthonormal representation in C10 is open in this work; the general (non-subsquare-label) 1RQLS10 problem and the noncyclic 600-cell complement remain open.
